pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Customer Chat History Before Claiming
lesson.when: the user asks whether their prior chat history or interaction details are retained on the system
lesson.do: state that information cannot be confirmed if official retrieved context or policy sources lack proof of the customer's prior interaction history
lesson.otherwise: state uncertainty about the chat history rather than inventing past interactions or product interest
triggers: bên em còn nội dung chat không
tra cứu lịch sử trao đổi
